reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for orchestrating subagents with model selection and presenting their live progress, task lists, and latest messages in interactive cards and dashboards.

summaries.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的子代理编排插件，可选择模型派发子代理并以交互式卡片实时查看其思考、任务清单和最新发言。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for dispatching subagents with selectable models and viewing their thinking, task lists, and latest messages in interactive live cards.

capabilities: dispatches subagents through a model-selectable subagent_ex tool
tracks subagent THINK, TODO, and SPEAKS events
renders live subagent status cards and dashboards
queries available provider and model combinations
